name: Easter Island

flag.description: A white field with a large red reimiro in the centre: a crescent-shaped breastplate whose two upturned tips end in carved heads.
flag.symbolism: The reimiro is a wooden pectoral ornament once worn by the island's chiefs and nobles, and the heads at its tips represent the ariki, the chiefs.

hook: Easter Island is a big red smile on white: the reimiro breastplate, with a tiny head on each upturned tip.
trivia: A reimiro flag was flown by the island's king in the 1880s; the modern version was first raised officially beside Chile's flag in 2006.
The Dutch explorer Jacob Roggeveen named it Easter Island because he arrived on Easter Sunday in 1722.
